The app models container capacity (derive.ts computes each container's load vs item.capacity.bulk and blocks over-capacity drops), so a +50% capacity on mundane containers and vehicles is a real sheet effect. No listed field or registry expresses a container-capacity multiplier — bulkLimitBonus is the character's own Bulk limit, which this feat explicitly does not change.

fix.note: Need a lane for a per-character multiplier on mundane container capacity (x1.5), excluding magical/extradimensional containers.

You immediately learn 10 languages of your choice — a real, player-picked sheet element. No feat in core.json carries any language field and there is no language lane on feats (OpenChoiceFrom's 'language' type is not reachable from a feat record), so nothing can deliver it.

fix.note: Need a feat-level lane to grant N languages (fixed or player-chosen). The ranged Identify Magic half is an action and needs nothing.

companionMod.note: Pale Horse: when you Mount your faithful steed, choose fire, poison, or void. While you ride it, the steed gains resistance 10 to that type, and any creature that touches it — including hitting it with an unarmed attack or with a melee weapon Strike while adjacent — takes 1d6 damage of that type (2d6 at 16th level, 3d6 at 20th).

Mutagens are real consumable MODES whose drawbacks are negative modifiers on the sheet (e.g. item-bendy-arm-mutagen-lesser's -1 Athletics). This feat removes those drawbacks for mutagens you crafted, and no field or registry can suppress part of a mode.

fix.note: Need a lane that suppresses the drawback (negative) modifiers of an active mutagen mode when the mutagen was crafted by this character; removesWeaknesses only handles weaknesses.
